messages:
sara (product): Quick check — console observability roadmap status? Need an async update for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones before Friday. Who owns what and any blockers?

mike (eng-runtime): Dashboards: basic metrics + per-route latency charts are wired. Still missing top-errors panel and perc50/90/99 breakdowns. Working on the queries today. ETA for dashboard v1: EOW.

jamal (eng-sre): Tracing hooks: core instrumentation merged, but we need one small change in the tracing agent to attach request metadata (customer_id, model_variant). PR: https://git.internal/r/trace-agent/pull/412 (review pending). Blocker: subtle perf reg on p99 when sampling enabled. Investigating.

olivia (devex): UX for dashboards: layout mock updated here https://designs.internal/obs-console/v3 — need final data shapes from Mike so panels render correctly. Also want to add a short tooltip for caching vs. serving cost items.

kevin (eng-oncall): Error-analysis views: prototype can show grouped stacktraces and most-frequent error messages. Need the error-aggregation index from logging infra (depends on eng-infra work). If infra can't finish index, we can fall back to grouping client-side (worse perf).

infra-bot: Deploy started: obs-console:staging -> infra-observability-cluster at 2024-11-12T09:34:12Z.

mike (eng-runtime): @jamal I can toggle sampling off for the canary to rule out perf hit. Jamal — can you post the perf trace when you repro?

jamal (eng-sre): Will do. Also flag: retention milestone — legal asked for a configurable default of 90 days, but some enterprise customers require 365. We need policy + audit logs. Draft retention config below: 
```
# observability retention (example)
error_events_retention_days: 90  # default
trace_kv_cache_days: 30
long_term_archive: enabled_for_enterprise_only
```

olivia (devex): For the tooltip UX and panel titles, I need the final metric names (e.g., `route.latency.p50`) — Mike can you share the exact metric keys?

mike (eng-runtime): Yup — p50/p90/p99 expose as `route.latency.p50`, `route.latency.p90`, `route.latency.p99`. Top errors -> `route.errors.top`. I'll add docs to the API spec.

kevin (eng-oncall): Dependency note: eng-infra ETA for error-aggregation index is Tue next week. If delayed, I can wire client-side grouping + a throttled fetch as fallback.

anna (eng-platform): Ownership clarifications: dashboards = Mike (eng-runtime) + Olivia (devex) for UX, tracing hooks = Jamal (eng-sre), error-analysis = Kevin (eng-oncall) with infra dependency, retention & compliance = Jamal + Legal (ops). Milestones: 
- Dashboard v1 (metrics + basic errors) — target: Fri (owner: Mike)
- Tracing hooks merged + sampling config — target: Tue (owner: Jamal)
- Error-analysis MVP (grouped errors + basic stack) — target: next Wed (owner: Kevin)
- Retention policy + audit work — target: next Thu (owner: Jamal)

mike (eng-runtime): Quick ping — I have a PR for dashboard panels but need one more review from @olivia and @anna. PR: https://git.internal/r/console/pull/287

olivia (devex): Reviewing now, left inline comments about responsive behavior.

jamal (eng-sre): Compliance question: for 365-day retention we need encryption-at-rest proof for logs. Legal asked for sample SLA language. @sara can you route the legal contact?

sara (product): Yep, looping in Legal in a separate thread. For roadmap planning, please update the ticket statuses in Jira: PROJ-459 (dashboards), PROJ-462 (tracing), PROJ-468 (error-analysis), PROJ-471 (retention). I'll pull the timeline into the cross-team status doc after CI jobs pass.

kevin (eng-oncall): Canary plan: will run canary on 10% of traffic Mon AM, monitor p99 and error-rate for 4 hours, auto-roll back if p99 increases > 20% or error-rate > 0.5%. Can we add an alert in console for that?

anna (eng-platform): Yes — alert rule: `when service.p99 > baseline * 1.2 for 5m OR error_rate > 0.005`. I will add it to the rollout policy.

mike (eng-runtime): One more ask: who can cut a short-release note for the dashboard v1 (2–3 bullet points)?

olivia (devex): I can draft the UX-focused bullets.

jamal (eng-sre): I'll draft the ops note about sampling and retention.

sara (product): Great. Last ask — any code review blockers that need help? If so, drop the PR link and I'll ping reviewers.

mike (eng-runtime): PR above — need anna or olivia approval.

olivia (devex): Approved, merged. :tada:

jamal (eng-sre): Tracing PR now has one remaining comment, will address today.

kevin (eng-oncall): If infra stays on track, error-analysis MVP will make the next demo cut.

sara (product): Thanks everyone. If anything slips, post updates in this thread. I'll schedule a 30-min async sync on Thu — https://calendar.internal/meet/obs-roadmap-checkin (please add blockers to the Jira tickets).

anna (eng-platform): Noted. I'll add the canary rollback playbook to the incident runbook repo.

infra-bot: Deploy completed: obs-console:staging -> infra-observability-cluster at 2024-11-12T09:42:01Z.

sara (product): Closing the loop — I'll publish a short status note to #product after the Thu check-in. Thanks all!
